observations.name: C: bundle expecting a foreign cluster
observations.expected: the session is refused (cluster_name_mismatch) and the bundle never becomes READY
observations.expectedBeforeFix: no cluster identity in 2.4.6: the bundle attaches to whatever server answers (G13)
observations.observed: healthy=false, busState READY=false, 39 cluster_name_mismatch line(s), feature null

observations.name: A: legacy single-id guard on failover
observations.expected: by contract the single expected id refuses every other server, even a healthy one of the same cluster (recorded on both image sets; the fix is variant B's cluster name)
observations.expectedBeforeFix: the single expected id rejects every healthy failover target: server_instance_mismatch loop (G13)
observations.observed: 0/3 acknowledged {error=3}; 7 mismatch log lines in 60 s

observations.name: A: EU bundles fail back to evento-eu once it is healthy again (N16)
observations.expected: every EU JVM that failed over to another server is attached to evento-eu again, without a restart, within 180 s
observations.expectedBeforeFix: no failback: they stay on the remote server until restarted (N16)
observations.observed: 7 JVM(s) remote while evento-eu was down {gateway-africa=evento-am, order-command-eu=evento-am, order-observer=evento-am, order-query-eu=evento-am, order-query-global-eu=evento-am, order-query-wildcard=evento-am, order-saga-eu=evento-am}; still remote after the wait: {}

observations.name: B: failover to a healthy server of the same cluster (cluster-name guard)
observations.expected: the bundle accepts any evento-lab-cluster server behind the VIP, EUROPA works again, and the cluster-name guard is active
observations.expectedBeforeFix: no cluster-name guard in 2.4.6: failover works only because nothing is checked (G13)
observations.observed: ready=true, 3/3 before the kill {}, 3/3 after {}; guard available: evento-lab-cluster
